description: This Java class is a service implementation for managing product availability entities within an e-commerce system. It extends a generic service implementation and provides the saveOrUpdate method to either create or update product availability data.

classes.name: ProductAvailabilityServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing product availability management, extending generic service, annotated as a Spring service.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new product availability or updates an existing one based on its ID.
